lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Namaskara madam, naanu Kaveri Finance inda maathadthiddini. Kavya Hegde avara jothe maathadthiddeena?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಹೌದು, ನಾನೇ Kavya. ನಿಮ್ಮಿಂದ ತುಂಬಾ calls ಬರ್ತಿವೆ, ಅದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆನೇ ಮಾತಾಡ್ಬೇಕಿತ್ತು.
lines.roman: Haudu, naane Kavya. Nimminda thumba calls barthive, adara baggene maathadbekitthu.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sure madam. This call is recorded for quality and for your protection. Before we proceed, please confirm the last four digits of your loan account.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you madam. Dayavittu enu problem anta poorti heli, naanu note maadkothini.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: October ಹತ್ತನೇ ತಾರೀಕು ನಾನು loan foreclose ಮಾಡಿದೆ, forty-two thousand three hundred branch ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿದೆ. Receipt ಕೂಡ ಇದೆ.
lines.roman: October hatthane thaareeku naanu loan foreclose maadide, forty-two thousand three hundred branch alli kattide. Receipt kooda ide.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಆದ್ರೂ ನಿಮ್ಮ system ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೂ three thousand one fifty due ಅಂತ ತೋರಿಸ್ತಿದೆ, NOC ಕೂಡ ಬಂದಿಲ್ಲ. ದಿನಾ calls ಬರ್ತಿವೆ, office ಅಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬಾ embarrassing ಆಗುತ್ತೆ.
lines.roman: Aadroo nimma system alli innu three thousand one fifty due anta thoristide, NOC kooda bandilla. Dina calls barthive, office alli thumba embarrassing aagutte.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Kshamisi madam, idu nimage thondre aagide. Foreclosure maadiddaroo due thoristide andre adu namma kade reconciliation problem irabahudu. Naanu eega dispute log maadthiddini.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Your reference number is K F D two four one one nine three. The reconciliation team will resolve it within seven working days, and I have put a hold on collection calls on your account until then.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Receipt photo na disputes at kaveri finance dot in ge kalisi, subject alli reference number haaki. Team nimage email mooloka update kodutte, resolve aada mele NOC kooda kalisthaare.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: To recap madam: dispute KFD241193 is logged for the three thousand one fifty showing after your October foreclosure, resolution within seven working days, no collection calls meanwhile, and you will email the receipt today.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Dispute logged with reference KFD241193, a seven-working-day timeline and collection calls on hold.
analysis.summary: Customer foreclosed her loan on 10 October (₹42,300 at branch) but the system still shows ₹3,150 due and no NOC has been issued. Agent listened fully, apologised, logged a dispute with a reference and timeline, and paused collection calls.
analysis.observations: Model dispute call: verification and recording disclosure up front, open prompt for the full story with no interruptions, ownership of a likely internal reconciliation error, and a precise recap including the customer's own action item.
analysis.improvements: Could confirm the registered email address on file so the update and NOC reach her.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Asked for last four digits of the loan account before discussing it.

op_recording_disclosure.rationale: Disclosed that the call is recorded.

dp_listen_fully.rationale: Invited the full explanation and only acknowledged ('heli') until the customer finished.

dp_log_ticket.rationale: Logged the dispute and shared reference KFD241193.

dp_timeline.rationale: Committed to resolution within seven working days.

dp_pause_collection.rationale: Confirmed a hold on collection calls until resolution.

cp_no_threats.rationale: No pressure or threats at any point.

cp_respectful.rationale: Apologised for the inconvenience and stayed courteous.

cl_next_step.rationale: Explained where to send the receipt and that the team will update by email and issue the NOC.

cl_recap.rationale: Recapped reference, issue, timeline, call hold and customer's action.
